card.name: Drug-interaction wording about affecting other drugs
card.fires_on: Words in drug-interaction passages where one drug's effect on another is being described, such as 'of', 'from', 'drugs' or partway through a drug name or 'inducers'. It appears right after a drug, enzyme or inducer term.

modes.label: Linking word after effect noun
modes.description: A short word like 'of' or 'from' after a verb or noun about metabolism, inducing or displacing in an interaction statement.
modes.example: nifedipine can inhibit the metabolism<< of>> drugs that are substrates of CYP

modes.label: Inside drug or inducer names
modes.description: The middle or end of a drug name or the word 'inducers' in interaction sections.
modes.example: Efavirenz, nevirapine, and etravirine are known CYP3A<< indu>>cers, whereas delavirdine is

modes.label: Other drugs in interaction headings
modes.description: The word 'drugs' or a drug name ending in interaction table titles or headings.
